gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Chunky, wide, unmistakable. Dogica sprawls across the top, while Noto Sans Bassa Vah, a plain sans with a big midsection, looks best when its size stays modest.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-batak: Dogica spreads out wide and heavy, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Noto Sans Batak follows with a towering x-height and an open e, so paragraphs of it stay friendly and never feel squeezed.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase. Under Dogica's heavy, widely spaced heading, its open letter mouths give the page a quiet counterweight and a steady place for the eye to rest.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Dogica's lowercase climbs almost to capital height, and its wide tracking gives every heading a commanding stretch. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki handles the reading, with open apertures that stay easy to follow.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Dogica's wide tracking and near-capital lowercase make it feel heavy and deliberate, with every curve left open at its end. Noto Sans Brahmi, with its high mean line, reads smoothly across a long passage.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Dogica is wide, heavy and tightly packed in height. Noto Sans Buginese, a sans-serif with open letter mouths and short ascenders, is what makes the pair work, giving the loud heading a quiet partner.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Commanding and heavy, Dogica stretches its wide tracking across the page and leaves every curve open. And Noto Sans Buhid, a modern sans with a high x-height, is better left to the text while the heading handles big, short lines.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-carian: Blocky, wide and loud. Dogica takes the heading, while Noto Sans Carian, a clean sans with terminals held apart, can sit in a size a bit smaller than you might expect.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Heavy, wide and sure of itself, Dogica leads with near-capital lowercase. But Noto Sans Chakma, with its uncrowded s and c, keeps a long passage approachable and easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham reads modern and clean, with rounded tall lowercase and generous entry space on its c. Beside Dogica's heavy heading, a long passage of it feels open and light, with plenty of room.
